claims.text: Grand Hyatt Goa overlooks the waters of Bambolim Bay.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Goa overlooks the visually stunning waters of the Bambolim Bay.
findings.note: Directly states the resort overlooks Bambolim Bay.

claims.text: The resort spreads across 28 acres of tropical gardens and lawns that roll down to the water's edge.

findings.quote: This hotel in Goa spreads across 28 acres of colourful, tropical gardens and lush lawns that roll down to the water’s edge.
findings.note: Matches the 28 acres, tropical gardens and lawns rolling to the water's edge.

claims.text: The architecture features soaring doors and windows, tiled roofs and recessed balconies with reflecting pools, alongside a ruined chapel and ancient banyans.

findings.quote: Grandly austere style with soaring doors, windows, and tiled roofs and cool, recessed balconies enhanced by reflecting pools, a picturesquely ruined chapel, and the convoluted contours of ancient banyans.
findings.note: Covers every architectural element named in the claim.

claims.text: Every room has a balcony with views of sunsets, the free-form swimming pool or tropical gardens.

findings.quote: Every room at Grand Hyatt Goa features a balcony offering relaxed seating with views of magical sunsets, free-form swimming pool or tropical gardens.
findings.note: Matches the balcony and view options in the claim.

claims.text: Suites have a whirlpool on the balcony overlooking gardens and ocean.

findings.quote: The 16 suites also feature a whirlpool in the suite balcony overlooking gardens and ocean.
findings.note: Suite balconies have whirlpools overlooking gardens and ocean.

claims.text: Rooms have a marble bathroom with a tub and a separate walk-in rain shower.

findings.quote: Enjoy a tub and separate walk-in rain shower in the spacious marble bathroom
findings.note: Room descriptions include a marble bathroom with a tub and separate rain shower.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has an outdoor tub overlooking Bambolim Bay, a private kitchen and a personal butler.

findings.quote: The suite also features an opulent marble bathroom with a walk-in shower and an outdoor tub overlooking Bambolim Bay.
findings.note: Covers the outdoor tub overlooking Bambolim Bay.

findings.quote: Additional highlights include a private kitchen, an in-room bar, a personal butler and a guest bathroom.
findings.note: Covers the private kitchen and personal butler.

claims.text: Shamana Spa blends modern therapies with ancient Indian traditions.

findings.quote: Enter a serene retreat at Shamana Spa, where modern therapies blend with ancient Indian traditions at Grand Hyatt Goa.
findings.note: Directly states the blend of modern therapies and ancient Indian traditions.

claims.text: The outdoor pool area has a leisure pool and a kids' pool facing Bambolim Bay.

findings.quote: Experience unmatched luxury in our outdoor pool area, featuring a leisure pool and a kids' pool facing Bambolim Bay.
findings.note: Directly matches the claim.

claims.text: There is also an indoor lap pool, with separate steam and sauna facilities next to the whirlpools.

findings.quote: Keep up with your fitness routine in our 25-metre indoor lap pool, then relax in separate steam and sauna facilities adjacent to our whirlpools.
findings.note: Covers the indoor lap pool and the steam and sauna next to the whirlpools.

claims.text: The Dining Room is an all-day restaurant with five live kitchens, including Asian, Indian and Italian choices.

findings.quote: This all-day-dining restaurant features five live kitchens, that embrace the idea of eating out of the pan, off the grill and out of the wok. Guests can enjoy a myriad of choices that include a taste of Asian, Indian, Italian and Middle Eastern cuisine
findings.note: Covers the all-day dining, five live kitchens and the Asian, Indian and Italian choices.

claims.text: Pool Bar and Grill sits steps from the bay, by the free-form outdoor pool.

findings.quote: Located just steps away from the bay, Pool Bar and Grill at Grand Hyatt Goa is designed to be the perfect place for refreshments, lunch or dinner while soaking in the free form outdoor pool.
findings.note: Covers the location steps from the bay and by the free-form outdoor pool.
